title: Opera Omnia S. Maximus Confessor 1 (Migne P.G. 90)
author: Maximus the Confessor
description: A collected volume of Maximus the Confessor's works in Migne's Patrologia Graeca. It offers access to the writings of a major Byzantine theologian concerned with Christ, creation and humanity's participation in divine life.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/opera-omnia-saint-maximus-confessor-1).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
